english.title: Furnish to a person acting in the execution of Horse Passports Regulations 2009 false / misleading information
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) furnished to **(..SPECIFY PERSON..), a person acting in the execution of the Horse Passport Regulations 2009, information, namely **(..SPECIFY INFORMATION..), knowing it to be false or misleading
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 21(c) and 22 of the Horse Passports Regulations 2009.

other.penalty:
Summary: A fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
Indictment: A fine.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
